scope: Real PostgreSQL two-session fill accounting contention, duplicate, overlapping cumulative fills, and rollback/waiting retry evidence. Tests only; no production edits.
database: New postgres:16-alpine container; dedicated internal Docker network, no host port; tmpfs database; synthetic test-only identity.
isolation: Read-only candidate-worktree mount; no installed state, credentials, data, or models; shadow/mock environment; scratch brain; only created resources removed.
test_contract: Explicit DSN validates dedicated host/database/user and no unexpected URL options.
Real PostgreSQL pg_blocking_pids proves second writer waits on first transaction, not only timing.
Commit and rollback outcomes prove execution/lot watermark and cumulative-VWAP cashflow; duplicate exit also verifies audit durability.
